item: A restore places a carried signing key wrapped under this install's passphrase, and never over a key that is there (R448)
summary: merge_side_files placed keys/ as carried (wrapped under the source install's passphrase, which blocked every export here) with exists() then os.replace (a key an export made in between was overwritten). _restore_key_members opens each carried Ed25519/ML-DSA key with this install's held passphrase, then the source corpus's and the backup's (StagedArtifact.key_passphrases, repr=False, set by read_artifact/read_volume_backup/read_stream_backup), seals it the way this install writes its own, reads it back before writing, and places it with keyfile.create_new (no clobber); a key none of them opens is not written and is named in report keys.not_placed.
